title: Two Colleagues Disagree About a Project Plan
script: Sari: [firmly] Bayu, I looked at your plan for the new app, and I don't think we should launch it in October.
Bayu: [surprised] Really? I thought October was already decided last week during the meeting.
Sari: [explaining] It was, but after I tested the app yesterday, I found three problems that we still need to fix.
Bayu: [concerned] What kind of problems are we talking about? Small ones, or something more serious?
Sari: [honestly] The login page crashes sometimes, and the payment system doesn't always save the information correctly.
Bayu: [worried] That does sound serious. If customers can't pay properly, they'll stop using the app immediately.
Sari: [calmly] Exactly, so I think we should delay the launch by three weeks, even though I know that's disappointing.
Bayu: [sighing] It is disappointing, because we already told our clients about the October date, but I understand your reasons.
Sari: [thoughtful] What if we explain the situation honestly? Clients usually respect a company more when it fixes problems before launching.
Bayu: [considering] That's true. I remember when we launched too early last year, and customers complained for months afterward.
Sari: [agreeing] Exactly, so although waiting feels frustrating now, it will probably save us a lot of trouble later.
Bayu: [determined] Okay, let's write an email to the clients today, so they have enough time to adjust their own plans.
Sari: [relieved] Thank you for understanding. I was worried you would think I was just trying to make more work for everyone.
Bayu: [warmly] Not at all. You caught these problems before our customers did, which is actually a good thing for the whole team.
Sari: [smiling] I appreciate that. Should we ask the developers to focus only on those three problems this week?
Bayu: [nodding] Yes, and I'll tell them the new deadline is in three weeks, not three days, so they don't panic.
Sari: [laughing a little] Good idea. Nobody works well when they feel panicked and rushed at the same time.
Bayu: [warmly] Agreed. Let's send that email now, and then we can plan the new testing schedule together this afternoon.

quiz.question: Why does Sari want to delay the app launch?
options: She is on vacation in October
She found three problems while testing the app
The clients asked for a delay
quiz.explanation: Sari found three problems, including login and payment issues, while testing the app.

quiz.question: What two problems does Sari mention specifically?
options: The login page crashes and the payment system doesn't save information correctly
Too many users and low storage
quiz.explanation: She mentions the login page crashing and the payment system not saving information correctly.

quiz.question: What happened when they launched a product too early last year?
quiz.explanation: Bayu remembers customers complaining for months after an early launch last year.

quiz.question: What do Sari and Bayu decide to do about the clients?
options: Write an honest email explaining the delay
quiz.explanation: They decide to write an email explaining the situation honestly to the clients.

quiz.question: How long does Bayu plan to tell the developers the new deadline is?
quiz.explanation: Bayu says he'll tell the developers the new deadline is three weeks, not three days.
